scientific_limits.method_change: Thirty-two training-only fixed starts plus explicit unrounded x/xsum diagnostic compositions; original uniform host products used source rounding. This is a joint method comparison, not a starting-point causal effect.

score_summary_scope: Equal weight per scored held-out fold within each baseline/window; point diagnostics only. Refused folds remain explicit; no cross-window rank or inferential independence.

observer_summary.scope: Previously exposed within-window point-pollen evidence only; no cross-window winner, untouched vegetation accuracy or age/field uncertainty calibration.
